reason: DELIBERATE departure from the React oracle (RB-13 of the #106 audit). WHAT REACT DOES: a nested DirectionProvider without a direction prop provides undefined, so consumers below it fall back to ltr (useDirection: localDir || contextDir || 'ltr'), silently resetting an outer rtl. WHAT THE PORT DOES: Direction::Provider without dir/direction keeps the outer direction (rtl stays rtl). WHY: an omitted value reads as 'no opinion', not 'ltr'; resetting to ltr on a missing argument is a trap for composed layouts. IMPACT: only a Provider with no dir nested inside a Provider with a direction; an explicit dir always wins, and a top-level Provider without dir still yields ltr. HOW IT IS PINNED: scenario nested__inner-without-dir-resets (outer rtl) was adapted to nested__inner-without-dir-ltr-outer, where React and the port agree; the rtl-outer behavior is asserted by the nested-Provider test in test/chadcn/direction_test.rb. REVISIT IF: shadcn changes DirectionProvider to inherit, then restore the rtl scenario and delete this entry. AWAITING: the owner's approval (approved-by in DEVIATIONS.md stays 'pending').
api: Direction::Provider: without dir, keeps the outer direction instead of resetting consumers to ltr (React DirectionProvider with no direction provides undefined)
